skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Describe cultural characteristics of various countries and regions around the world.
Explain the relationship between cultural characteristics and linguistic and non-verbal communication features.
Apply cultural characteristics and communication principles to explain the reasons for success/failure in intercultural communication scenarios.
Follow and simulate guidelines for intercultural communication in simulated situations.
Perform intercultural communication activities with consideration for cultural exchange factors.
Proactively participate in learning and research activities related to culture and intercultural communication.
Contribute to learning and research activities related to culture and intercultural communication.
